reviews.text:
They were instructed not to cut our Goldens.  Rather than brush out knots they cut.  One of our Goldens looks like a poodle.  Nobody with a
Long haired dog should ever use Puff and Fluf.  It will be Christmas before our dogs are back to normal.
I love this dog grooming place! They always do such a great job. Shoutout to Julia, she is amazing! My dog is obsessed with her and absolutely loves getting groomed.

Fluff Bar did an amazing job grooming my girl!  She looked absolutely gorgeous when I picked her up and she is so much more comfortable with her shorter haircut in the summer heat.

Fluff Bar, made sure my puppy was comfortable and well cared for.  They really tried to connect with my dog and establish a trusting relationship with my skittish and shy little girl.

Thank you Fluff Bar!  We will be back.

Our sweet doodle has been a Fluff Bar patron for the last 5 years, and I cannot recommend this team highly enough!

Their team is extremely professional, personable and so kind to their clients (human and dogs). Fluff Bar’s prices are reasonable and comparable to other groomers in the Valley. They offer full service grooming and many additional fun services for your pets!

If you want to support a women-owned business, this is your spot. We’re so proud of Kristi and her team as they’ve grown from one location to three! My family and Piper are so grateful to call you friends and family 💛 Congratulations on your newest edition ✨
My dog is usually so nervous about nail trims but she did great at the Fluff Bar, thanks to Kristi and her team. It was a wonderful experience and we'll definitely be back time and again!

Kristi and Melissa groomed my two large Doodles today. I was extremely happy when I picked them up. I've been taking them to groomers for 10 years now and have never been so satisfied with the service and outcome! They were extremely soft, and the attention to detail was very clear. I highly recommend going to Fluff Bar!
Our pup, Binji loved his experience at Fluff Bar Biltmore. Great new location! We’re loyal to Kristi and her work. The best in town!

My Pup Rosie absolutely loved her first spa visit to Fluff Bar at the Biltmore!!! She was so happy to get all fluffed, pampered and trimmed Kristi did an amazing job making her feel special!! I can't wait to bring her back!!

Always a great experience with Fluff Bar, and I'm so glad that they expanded to be closer to me. Very clean environment, clear and professional communication, and they are so gentle with my pup. It can be scary trusting a stranger with your pet, but I feel confident in their care and my pup always comes home smelling great and looking adorable. I also love that they have a bandana add-on at no extra charge :) Melissa is the best and I will always come back to Fluff Bar!
Staff are professional and courteous! Great clean new space!
Such the sweetest crew! The owner is the best. They car we about your pups like family! Super excited
Best hair cut my dog has ever had!! 10/10
